hazards: The first section takes no protection, and the rock there crumbles; a nut has pulled out on it. A fall low on this route would be serious.

The sandstone here is soft; roughly half of the wedge bolts and hangers are worn or spinning in place, so inspect fixed gear before weighting it. Rattlesnakes are a known hazard on the access trail and at the base. Park is closed seasonally Nov 1 - Mar 15
